detalhes: Fonte: EC-OECD STIP Compass (Comissão Europeia e OCDE), edição 2025 da pesquisa STIP (dados atualizados até setembro de 2026); iniciativa 14098, informada pelo governo do Brasil; última atualização no STIP: 11/08/2025. Iniciativa: Legal Framework on Science, Technology and Innovation - Law 13.243 of January 11, 2016 (Marco Legal de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação - Lei 13.243, de 11 de janeiro de 2016). País: Brasil. Período: desde 2016, sem data de término informada. Relação com o tema: política de formação e carreira em CTI que não menciona mulheres nem gênero (temas: Carreiras de pesquisa). A descrição não fala de mulheres nem de gênero. Responsável: Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock and Supply (MAPA; Ministério da Agricultura, Pecuária e Abastecimento); Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (MCTI; Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação); Ministry of Finance (MF; Ministério da Fazenda); Ministry of Health (MS; Ministério da Saúde). Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): Federal law established to foster the scientific development, research, scientific and technological capacity-building and innovation. Objetivos: 1) Foster scientific and technological activities as strategies for economic and social development. 2) Foster cooperation and interaction among public and private sectors, and companies. 3) Strengthen operational, scientific, technological and administrative capacities of scientific and technological institutions. Público-alvo: Pesquisadores estabelecidos; Investidores privados; Empreendedores; Instituições de ensino superior; Institutos públicos de pesquisa; Laboratórios privados de P&D; Governo nacional; Governos subnacionais; Empresas de qualquer idade; Empresas de qualquer porte; Incubadoras, aceleradoras e parques tecnológicos; Escritórios de transferência de tecnologia. Temas no STIP: Mudança estrutural no sistema público de pesquisa; Internacionalização da pesquisa pública; Mobilidade intersetorial; Carreiras de pesquisa; Governança internacional de CTI. Instrumentos: Estratégias, agendas e planos (Legal Framework on Science, Technology and Innovation - Law 13.243 of January 11, 2016); orçamento anual informado: não se aplica (o arquivo do STIP não informa a moeda); avaliação: sem avaliação informada. Contexto: Law no. 13.243, 2016 alters Law no. 10.973, 2004 (Innovation Law) and aims to foster cooperation between public research institutions and the private sector. (continuação) The new legislation states that the government must have specific policies concerning the internationalization of PRIs, including aspects such as funding, management and support. Full implementation of the new legislation, however, need further regulation by executive order.

Contexto: CONICET has always been involved in the training of scientists. In the present it finances one third of the doctoral students in the country. Changes in policy are related to regional and disciplinary priorities.

tipo: Política ou iniciativa de CTI (OECD STIP Compass)

detalhes: Fonte: EC-OECD STIP Compass (Comissão Europeia e OCDE), edição 2025 da pesquisa STIP (dados atualizados até setembro de 2026); iniciativa 14432, informada pelo governo da Argentina; última atualização no STIP: 17/04/2026. Iniciativa: National Program of Alphabetization (Plan Nacional de Alfabetización). País: Argentina. Período: de 2024 a 2070. Relação com o tema: política de formação e carreira em CTI que não menciona mulheres nem gênero (temas: Competências STEM). A descrição não fala de mulheres nem de gênero. Responsável: National Council of Education. Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): The National Literacy Plan is a public policy coordinated between the national government and the 24 jurisdictions of Argentina, aimed at reversing the reading comprehension deficit and ensuring that all children in the country learn to read and write properly. Objetivos: 1) The primary goal is to ensure that all students in the Argentine Republic can effectively read, comprehend, and produce texts that are appropriate for their educational level. 2) Early Literacy Mastery: Guarantee the development of appropriate reading and writing skills for students by the time they reach 3rd grade. 3) Continuous Support: Provide equitable literacy opportunities to accelerate learning for students from 4th grade onwards. 4) Systematic Tracking: Develop and implement tracking and evaluation mechanisms that allow for continuous improvements in the quality and equity of education. Público-alvo: Governo nacional; Governos subnacionais. Temas no STIP: Competências STEM. Instrumentos: Inteligência de políticas (avaliações, comparações e prospecção); orçamento anual informado: de 1 a 5 milhões (o arquivo do STIP não informa a moeda); avaliação: sem avaliação informada.

Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): The program finances postdoctorate research projects for scientific development, through labor insertion into academic or another field. It supports their incorporation into consolidated research groups which, in turn, will be strengthened by their participation. Objetivos: 1) The main objective of this contest is to stimulate the productivity and future scientific leadership of young researchers with an academic degree of Doctor, by supporting their research projects. 2) Support young researchers labor insertion into academic or another field. 3) Incorporation of researchers into consolidated research groups which will contribute to their scientific development and, in turn, will be strengthened by their participation. Público-alvo: Pós-doutorandos e pesquisadores em início de carreira. Temas no STIP: Pesquisadores de doutorado e pós-doutorado. Instrumentos: Bolsas de estudo, de pesquisa e de pós-graduação; avaliação: sem avaliação informada. Contexto: Fondecyt exclusively finances scientific or technological research initiatives, that is, that lead to new knowledge or applications foreseen through work hypotheses specified in the proposal itself. It does not finance artistic creation initiatives, compilations, catalogues or inventories, printing of books, essays, translations, audio-visual material, teaching texts or other analogous activities.

País: Colômbia. Período: desde 1996, sem data de término informada. (continuação) Contexto: The process of recognition and measurement of research groups and researchers in Colombia began in 1996, when Colciencias defined research groups as the fundamental unit for generating and applying scientific knowledge. Over the years, the model evolved through multiple adjustments, such as the introduction of the ScientiCol index, differentiated categorizations (A1, A, B, C, D), and the adoption of platforms like GrupLAC and CvLAC for real-time information management. In 2024, the Ministry of Science, Technology, and Innovation updated the process to further promote inclusion and research quality by introducing differentiated evaluation windows for women researchers with children, increasing the weight of social appropriation of knowledge and public science communication outputs, and recognizing open-access publications. This continuous evolution reflects Colombia’s commitment to strengthening its National STI System by improving the visibility, evaluation, and quality of scientific and technological production.

En 2020 y 2021 se destinó en promedio el 45% del presupuesto del Programa de Becas de Posgrado para promover la igualdad entre mujeres y hombres. Del total de Becas al Extranjero Administradas, 44.6% se asignaron a mujeres, mientras que 55.4% a hombres.

detalhes: Fonte: EC-OECD STIP Compass (Comissão Europeia e OCDE), edição 2025 da pesquisa STIP (dados atualizados até setembro de 2026); iniciativa 200001604, informada pelo governo do Brasil; última atualização no STIP: 01/07/2025. Iniciativa: 5th National Science, Technology and Innovation Conference - Violet Book (5a. Conferência Nacional de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação) [5a. CNCTI]. País: Brasil. Período: de 2025 a 2030. Relação com o tema: política de CTI que inclui mulheres, gênero ou parentalidade entre seus objetivos ou públicos (o governo marcou Mulheres entre os grupos-alvo; o governo marcou o tema Equidade, diversidade e inclusão; o texto menciona mulheres ou gênero). Trecho sobre mulheres, gênero ou parentalidade: "Promote equity and diversity in science by including women, Black people, indigenous peoples and other marginalised groups in research policies, implementing racial and gender quotas, creating gender equity committees, and supporting parenting in science.". Responsável: Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation - Brazil (MCTI; Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação - Brasil). Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): The 5th National Science, Technology and Innovation Conference (CNCTI) highlighted the social role of science through free conferences. These events culminated in the creation of the e-book Social Participation in the Preparatory Events of the 5th CNCTI. The Purple Book contains the report of the national stage of the 5th CNCTI and other related initiatives. Objetivos: 1) Promote the solidarity economy and social inclusion by creating integrated public policies focused on cooperatives and production networks, and establish ongoing calls for proposals to support initiatives in this field. 2) Develop assistive technologies by creating a national system for their development and distribution, alongside specific financing programmes for projects in this sector, ensuring accessibility especially in vulnerable regions. 3) Strengthen agroecology and family farming by creating a science, technology and innovation platform focused on agroecology, enhancing research with indigenous and traditional communities, promoting family farming with adapted innovations, and establishing a rural extension network. 4) Promote equity and diversity in science by including women, Black people, indigenous peoples and other marginalised groups in research policies, implementing racial and gender quotas, creating gender equity committees, and supporting parenting in science.

Período: de 2024 a 2030. Responsável: Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation - Brazil (MCTI; Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação - Brasil). Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): The Lilac Book compiles information and recommendations gathered during the three days of the National Conference. It serves as the foundation for developing the new national strategy for Science, Technology and Innovation (ST&I) covering the period up to 2030, along with an action plan addressing societal challenges to foster a fair, sustainable, and developed Brazil. Objetivos: 1) Reinforce the alignment of science, technology and innovation policies with social demands to promote sustainable and inclusive development in Brazil. 2) Stimulate the emergence of programmes that contribute to reducing social inequalities, tackling climate change, and promoting equitable access to knowledge. 3) Promote policies and programmes for communicating science to society, emphasising popularising science and strengthening scientific education. 4) Expand programmes for Technological Diffusion, Social Technologies, and Creative and Solidarity Economy to foster inclusion and social development. 5) Increase the participation of underrepresented groups in science, technology, and innovation to ensure greater diversity and inclusion. 6) Incentivise programmes integrating ancestral technologies with modern science to generate creative, sustainable solutions that value traditional knowledge. Público-alvo: Mulheres; Grupos desfavorecidos e excluídos; Sociedade civil. Trecho sobre mulheres, gênero ou parentalidade: "Promote diversity, equity and inclusion by encouraging participation of girls and women, people with disabilities, indigenous people, black people, traditional communities, and LGBTQIA+ individuals in science popularisation.". Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): The National Programme for Science Popularisation (POPCiencia) aims to develop scientific culture and stimulate the practice of science, technology and innovation. It focuses on promoting social inclusion and reducing social inequalities through these efforts. Objetivos: 1) Promote scientific literacy and literacy in Brazilian society. 2) Promote diversity, equity and inclusion by encouraging participation of girls and women, people with disabilities, indigenous people, black people, traditional communities, and LGBTQIA+ individuals in science popularisation. 3) Encourage science popularisation initiatives that respect the environment, regional and cultural diversity, and recognise traditional knowledge and its technologies. 4) Support science popularisation initiatives that stimulate the use of digital technologies to promote digital inclusion and innovation in science dissemination. 5) Encourage actions to popularise science reaching various societal groups beyond academia, especially young people and workers, including training and scholarships for students involved in science fairs and olympiads. 6) Combat scientific misinformation through scientific, media and digital education, and promote public engagement via innovative communication processes. Público-alvo: Estudantes de graduação e mestrado; Doutorandos; Professores; Mulheres; Grupos desfavorecidos e excluídos; Força de trabalho em geral. The initiative supports the pedagogical use of digital tools and fosters collaboration between schools, higher education institutions, and civil society. Público-alvo: Professores; Estudantes do ensino médio. Temas no STIP: Competências STEM; Cultura de ciência, tecnologia e inovação. Instrumentos: Campanhas de conscientização e divulgação; avaliação: sem avaliação informada. Contexto: The programme is led by the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation in Brazil. It seeks to intensify the qualification of basic education teachers in scientific, digital and media education and to foster communities of practice among basic and higher education teachers to reduce the research-practice gap.

Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): The National Data Centers Plan (PDATA) is a cross-sectoral policy initiative led by the Government of Chile that aims to position the country as a Latin American hub for sustainable digital infrastructure. It promotes investment in the data centre industry while ensuring environmental responsibility, territorial equity, and technological development in areas such as artificial intelligence and renewable energy. The Plan includes regulatory simplification, public-private coordination, and strategic investments in infrastructure, talent, and digital capacity. Objetivos: 1) Encourage the growth of the Data Center industry through investment support by clarifying regulations and organising relevant information to provide certainty to investors and make Chile an attractive destination for digital infrastructure investment while maintaining high environmental standards. 2) Build a decentralised Data Center industry with low environmental impact, powered by renewable energy, reducing energy and water consumption, enhancing resilience to climate challenges, and promoting balanced economic growth benefiting all regions equitably. 3) Strengthen research and development (R&D) to support the growth of data technologies by promoting R&D, training specialised workers, introducing new technologies, and enhancing collaboration between the public sector, academia, and industry to support the digital economy and benefit the population. Responsável: National Planning Department (DNP; Departamento Nacional de Planeación); Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Tourism (MINCIT; Ministerio de Comercio, Industria y Turismo). Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): The reindustrialisation policy aims to increase the generation of added value in the production of goods and services across economic sectors through a cross-cutting commitment to territories and their productive fabric, alongside intersectoral strategic initiatives at the national level. It lays the groundwork for transitioning from an economy dependent on extractive activities to a knowledge-based, productive, sustainable, and inclusive economy that contributes to territorial development and closes productivity gaps. Objetivos: 1) Strengthen the capabilities of human talent, the use and adoption of technologies, access to capital and financing, and physical and digital infrastructure to increase efficiency in the production of goods and services and close productivity gaps. 2) Increase the diversification and sophistication of the Colombian productive matrix by strengthening productive vocations and quality standards to reduce dependence on the mining and energy sector and increase domestic and exportable supply. 3) Strengthen the consolidation of productive linkages between sectors and regions of the Colombian economy, as well as its integration into global value chains. 4) Deepen Colombia's integration with Latin America and the Caribbean, Asia, Africa, Europe, and North America to balance its international relations and enhance the use of its FDI flows. 5) Implement improvements to the institutional and incentive framework to increase value added and thus productivity, competitiveness, and innovation. Público-alvo: Governo nacional; Empresas de qualquer porte. Responsável: Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation - Brazil (MCTI; Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação - Brasil). Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): The Biomes of Brazil Program, led by Brazil’s Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (MCTI) under the Program for Biodiversity Research (PPBio), focuses on the conservation and sustainable management of the country’s six major biomes: Amazonia, Cerrado, Caatinga, Atlantic Forest, Pantanal, and Pampa. It employs standardised ecological monitoring methods such as the RAPELD methodology and fosters partnerships with Indigenous groups and institutions. The programme maintains open-access biodiversity databases and supports applied research, digitisation of biological collections, and integration of findings into strategies addressing deforestation, climate risks, and bioeconomy development. Objetivos: 1) Advance biodiversity research and monitoring through standardised methodologies (e.g., RAPELD) for cross-biome ecological studies. 2) Strengthen conservation strategies across Brazil’s six biomes to address deforestation and climate impacts. 3) Promote sustainable use of biodiversity by integrating traditional knowledge from Indigenous and local communities with scientific research. 4) Develop open-access databases (e.g., SiBBr) and digitise biological collections to democratise biodiversity data for policymakers and stakeholders. 5) Support capacity building through training programmes for researchers, students, and communities in biodiversity management. 6) Align with national and global policies, including Brazil’s National Biodiversity Policy, Sustainable Development Goals, and the Convention on Biological Diversity. Contexto: Established in 2004, the Biomes of Brazil Program emphasises long-term ecological research, standardised monitoring, and cross-biome data comparability to tackle threats such as deforestation, climate change, and biodiversity loss. It operates through regional networks coordinated by institutions like the Emílio Goeldi Museum and the National Institute of Amazonian Research. Core activities include biodiversity inventories, digitisation of biological collections, and applied research on ecosystem services, biomolecules, and climate resilience. The programme prioritises capacity building by training researchers and local communities in conservation techniques while maintaining open-access databases to democratise biodiversity data. Despite generating over 1,200 scientific publications and informing conservation strategies in vulnerable regions such as the Cerrado, the programme faces challenges including inconsistent funding, regional disparities in resource allocation, and balancing industrial growth with ecological preservation. detalhes: Fonte: EC-OECD STIP Compass (Comissão Europeia e OCDE), edição 2025 da pesquisa STIP (dados atualizados até setembro de 2026); iniciativa 200002365, informada pelo governo da Colômbia; última atualização no STIP: 23/07/2025. Iniciativa: Mission-Oriented Research and Innovation Policies (Políticas de Investigación e Innovación Orientadas por Misiones) [PIIOM]. País: Colômbia. Período: desde 2022, sem data de término informada. Relação com o tema: política de CTI que inclui mulheres, gênero ou parentalidade entre seus objetivos ou públicos (o governo marcou Mulheres entre os grupos-alvo; o texto menciona mulheres ou gênero). Responsável: Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (MINCIENCIAS; Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación). Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): Within the framework of the National Science, Technology and Innovation Policy, the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (Minciencias) promotes mission-oriented research and innovation policies (PIIOM) as a transformative strategy to address the country's structural challenges and reduce territorial, social and productive gaps. This approach fosters the articulation of scientific, technological and social capabilities through an action research methodology that prioritises collective challenges and the construction of situated knowledge. It guides public investment towards measurable and highly relevant results by connecting knowledge generation with the real needs of territories and their populations. The initiative also integrates policy instruments with a differential approach to generate significant and tailored impacts in line with the social, cultural, environmental and economic realities of each territory. detalhes: Fonte: EC-OECD STIP Compass (Comissão Europeia e OCDE), edição 2025 da pesquisa STIP (dados atualizados até setembro de 2026); iniciativa 200002421, informada pelo governo da Colômbia; última atualização no STIP: 23/07/2025. Iniciativa: Vision STEM+. País: Colômbia. Período: desde 2022, sem data de término informada. Relação com o tema: política de formação e carreira em CTI que não menciona mulheres nem gênero (temas: Estratégias de recursos humanos em CTI). A descrição não fala de mulheres nem de gênero. Responsável: Ministry of Education (MEN; Ministerio de Educación Nacional). Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): Vision STEM+ is a continuation of a roadmap initiated in 2019 by the Ministry of National Education (MEN) and Parque Explora. Through the strategy "Supernova, expanded learning," it explored the state of the art of the STEM/STEAM approach, conducted the NovaCamp camp, and launched the MEN Creative Territory laboratory. Objetivos: 1) To gather the progress made so far to initiate broad conversations that validate a national vision. 2) To serve as a conceptual and methodological platform that articulates other policies within the educational innovation ecosystem related to this approach. 3) To align ongoing efforts towards transforming pedagogical practices through active methodologies, curricular flexibility, interdisciplinarity, and the promotion of 21st-century skills. 4) To establish a system of priorities that advances the implementation of the STEM+ approach. Público-alvo: Professores; Governo nacional; Governos subnacionais; Estudantes do ensino médio. Temas no STIP: Estratégias de recursos humanos em CTI. Instrumentos: Estratégias, agendas e planos (Visión STEM+); avaliação: sem avaliação informada. Contexto: Following these experiences, it became evident that Colombia needed a solid conceptual stance to define a national strategy. In 2020, the Organisation of Ibero-American States (OEI) joined the effort to shape this vision. The 2019 work was revisited, references were updated, co-creation sessions and dissemination events were held, and ideas were synthesised. The result is this publication.

Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): This initiative invites public and private Higher Education Institutions (HEIs), Public Centres for Humanistic and Scientific Research, Technological Development and Innovation, and federal and state public sector institutions that meet the target population criteria to participate jointly with international institutions and research centres. Relação com o tema: política de CTI que inclui mulheres, gênero ou parentalidade entre seus objetivos ou públicos (o governo marcou o tema Equidade, diversidade e inclusão; o texto menciona mulheres ou gênero). Trecho sobre mulheres, gênero ou parentalidade: "Promote the development of scientific vocations and 21st century skills associated with the STEAM approach in girls, boys and adolescents using programming, computer science and/or robotics in STEAM learning environments called STEAM Labs.". Responsável: Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (MINCIENCIAS; Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación). Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): The Colombia Robotics Program is an initiative by the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation aimed at strengthening the STEAM component in education across Colombia. It focuses on creating learning environments equipped with technological tools and training teachers to use these technologies effectively. The programme also facilitates collaboration among actors in the National System of Science, Technology and Innovation (SNCTI) to promote knowledge exchange and social appropriation of scientific knowledge. Currently, it is implementing 29 STEAM laboratories in 13 departments, benefiting thousands of children, adolescents and teachers through pedagogical strategies and technological appropriation. Objetivos: 1) Promote the development of scientific vocations and 21st century skills associated with the STEAM approach in girls, boys and adolescents using programming, computer science and/or robotics in STEAM learning environments called STEAM Labs. 2) Strengthen scientific vocations through the creation of learning environments with technological equipment and the training of teachers in the use of technological tools. 3) Facilitate the articulation of SNCTI actors for knowledge exchange and link professionals with doctorates in a strategy of social appropriation of knowledge. Público-alvo: Professores; Estudantes do ensino médio. Temas no STIP: Pesquisa e inovação colaborativas; Estratégias de recursos humanos em CTI; Competências STEM; Equidade, diversidade e inclusão (EDI).

These laboratories serve as convergence centres for the productive sector, academia and community initiatives, enabling the recognition and exchange of diverse knowledge and practices. They also support the incorporation and adaptation of technologies to local needs following international standards. Responsável: Ministry of Education (MEN; Ministerio de Educación Nacional). Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): Developed through a collective process starting in 2019, the Ministry of Education (MEN) shared a series of guidelines aimed at fostering educational innovation within schools. These guidelines provide a framework to support educational communities in enhancing quality and equity in education by addressing contemporary challenges in global and local education systems. Objetivos: 1) Explain the meaning and relevance of educational innovation, including concepts, processes, and the development of an innovative culture that positively influences daily school life, teachers' professional lives, and students' learning processes, supporting educational communities in solving school development problems. 2) Provide guidelines for promoting educational innovation across five areas: governance and institutional management; curriculum and pedagogical practices; teacher capacity development; pedagogical knowledge management; and networks and alliances forming an educational innovation ecosystem, all with a territorial approach recognising regional and institutional differences. 3) Describe the monitoring, follow-up, and evaluation model led by the Ministry of Education to measure and periodically monitor educational innovation programmes and initiatives in schools, including access to and use of digital technologies in education. Público-alvo: Professores; Governo nacional; Governos subnacionais; Estudantes do ensino médio. Temas no STIP: Avaliação e análise de impacto; Estratégias de recursos humanos em CTI. detalhes: Fonte: EC-OECD STIP Compass (Comissão Europeia e OCDE), edição 2025 da pesquisa STIP (dados atualizados até setembro de 2026); iniciativa 200002573, informada pelo governo da Colômbia; última atualização no STIP: 23/07/2025. Iniciativa: Young Researchers and Innovators Program (Jóvenes Investigadores e Innovadores) [JII]. País: Colômbia. Período: desde 1995, sem data de término informada. Relação com o tema: política de CTI que inclui mulheres, gênero ou parentalidade entre seus objetivos ou públicos (o governo marcou o tema Equidade, diversidade e inclusão). Responsável: Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (MINCIENCIAS; Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación). Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): The Young Researchers and Innovators Program targets individuals aged 18 to 28 who are currently studying or have recently graduated. It provides opportunities for Colombian technicians, technologists, and professionals to engage in research and innovation through a 12-month scholarship-internship in I+D+i projects. Objetivos: 1) Strengthen young people's scientific vocations by developing skills and competencies in Science, Technology and Innovation (STI). 2) Train high-quality researchers to enhance the country's scientific and technological capacity and position it to compete internationally at the highest standards, especially in strategic areas identified as national development priorities. 3) Encourage the generation, transfer, and social appropriation of knowledge by young researchers and innovators, as well as early-stage research teams. Público-alvo: Estudantes de graduação e mestrado; Pós-doutorandos e pesquisadores em início de carreira; Doutorandos; Grupos desfavorecidos e excluídos. Temas no STIP: Estratégias de recursos humanos em CTI; Competências STEM; Carreiras de pesquisa; Equidade, diversidade e inclusão (EDI). Instrumentos: Bolsas de estudo, de pesquisa e de pós-graduação (Call for Proposals Aimed at Strengthening the Multipurpose Cadastre through the Engagement of Young Researchers and Innovators – 1047); Bolsas de estudo, de pesquisa e de pós-graduação (Call for Strengthening the Hydrocarbons Sector in Colombia through the Engagement of Young Researchers and Innovators – 941 (Young Researchers and Innovators)); Bolsas de estudo, de pesquisa e de pós-graduação (Nexo Global France: Programme D'initiation à la Recherche pour le Premier Cycle);

Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): The Science, Technology, and Innovation (STI) Interest Centers with a STEM+ approach are a strategic initiative coordinated with the Ministry of National Education. They aim to consolidate alternative and innovative learning spaces that support the holistic development of children, adolescents, and youth in Colombia. The initiative fosters enriched educational environments that encourage curiosity, inquiry, experimentation, and critical thinking by addressing real-world problems through scientific and technological perspectives. It involves 12 education secretariats to build institutional and territorial capacities, strengthening territorial governance and ensuring the sustainability and relevance of actions over the medium and long term. Objetivos: 1) Promote the development of 21st-century skills and competencies for the holistic education of preschool, primary, and secondary school children and adolescents within strategies to expand and redefine school time. Público-alvo: Estudantes de graduação e mestrado; Professores; Estudantes do ensino médio. Contexto: Interest centres are pedagogical strategies that serve as alternative spaces for learning and holistic development, connected to students' motivations, needs, and interests. They enable exploration, research, enjoyment, and pleasure, linking schools to communities and integrating diverse knowledge to expand students' understanding of the world. (continuação) The STI Centres of Interest with a STEM+ approach represent a strategic initiative led in coordination with the Ministry of National Education to consolidate these innovative learning spaces for children, adolescents, and young people in Colombia.

Iniciativa: CONPES 4069 (Política Nacional de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación 2022 2031). País: Colômbia. Período: desde 2022, sem data de término informada. Relação com o tema: política de CTI que inclui mulheres, gênero ou parentalidade entre seus objetivos ou públicos (o governo marcou Mulheres entre os grupos-alvo). Responsável: Administrative Department of the Civil Service (DAFP; Departamento Administrativo de la Función Pública). Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): The CONPES 4069 initiative establishes Colombia's national policy for science, technology, and innovation from 2022 to 2031. It sets the framework for advancing these fields to support the country's social, economic, and environmental development. Objetivos: 1) Increase the contribution of science, technology, and innovation to Colombia's social, economic, environmental, and sustainable development with a differential, territorial, and participatory approach. 2) Increase scientific vocations among youth, improve CTI training, and integrate highly qualified human capital into the labour market. 3) Enhance the capacity for scientific and technological knowledge generation, infrastructure, and capabilities of research institutions. 4) Improve conditions for innovation and technology transfer to increase productivity and innovation levels in the country. 5) Increase social inclusion in CTI development and strengthen regional and international cooperation. 6) Improve institutional articulation, regulatory frameworks, and strategic intelligence for better governance of the CTI system. Público-alvo: Pesquisadores estabelecidos; Doutorandos; Mulheres; Instituições de ensino superior; Institutos públicos de pesquisa; Pequenas e médias empresas. Temas no STIP: Coordenação horizontal de políticas; Plano ou estratégia de CTI; Inteligência estratégica de políticas; Infraestruturas de pesquisa e tecnologia; Estratégias de recursos humanos em CTI; Participação de múltiplos atores. Instrumentos: Estratégias, agendas e planos (POLÍTICA NACIONAL DE CIENCIA, TECNOLOGÍA E INNOVACIÓN 2022 2031 - CONPES); avaliação: sem avaliação informada. Contexto: CONPES 4069 updates Colombia's national policy for science, technology, and innovation by building on previous policies and incorporating recommendations from the 2019 Misión Internacional de Sabios. It aims to address current challenges in CTI and align the country's strategy with global trends.

detalhes: Fonte: EC-OECD STIP Compass (Comissão Europeia e OCDE), edição 2025 da pesquisa STIP (dados atualizados até setembro de 2026); iniciativa 200002640, informada pelo governo da Colômbia; última atualização no STIP: 23/07/2025. Iniciativa: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Roadmap for Colombia (Hoja de Ruta de la Inteligencia Artificial (IA) para Colombia). País: Colômbia. Período: de 2024 a 2031. Relação com o tema: política de CTI que inclui mulheres, gênero ou parentalidade entre seus objetivos ou públicos (o governo marcou Mulheres entre os grupos-alvo; o texto menciona mulheres ou gênero). Trecho sobre mulheres, gênero ou parentalidade: "Increase the participation of women and underrepresented groups in AI by 50% through educational and training programmes, ensuring a diverse and competent workforce in the field.". Responsável: Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (MINCIENCIAS; Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación). Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): The roadmap, prepared by the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation, outlines Colombia's strategic approach to the ethical and sustainable adoption of artificial intelligence. It includes five strategic work environments, focusing on ethics and governance to promote transparency in algorithms, encourage citizen participation in decision-making, and establish ethical principles and regulatory frameworks for AI development and implementation. Objetivos: 1) Ensure that the Colombian population understands and trusts the artificial intelligence applications developed by organisations through the implementation of 100% of applications that guarantee user privacy, are transparent, responsible and fair, promoting a positive perception and informed participation in society and digital government. 2) Increase the participation of women and underrepresented groups in AI by 50% through educational and training programmes, ensuring a diverse and competent workforce in the field. 3) Implement solid ethical frameworks for the implementation of AI applications, so that 100% of data governance in the field of artificial intelligence is governed by ethical and legal principles. 4) Increase the adoption of artificial intelligence in 50% of companies and government sectors, generating trust through demonstration solutions and continuous education, relying on Colombia's digital government initiatives.

Iniciativa: Your Business Online (Tu Negocio en Línea) [TNL 2024-2026]. País: Colômbia. Período: de 2023 a 2026. Relação com o tema: política de formação e carreira em CTI que não menciona mulheres nem gênero (temas: Competências STEM). A descrição não fala de mulheres nem de gênero. Responsável: Ministry of Information and Communication Technologies (MINTIC; Ministerio de Tecnologías de la Información y las Comunicaciones). Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): This initiative promotes the use and adoption of technology to strengthen e-commerce among merchants and the business sector in Colombia. It aims to improve the digital skills of Colombian merchants and micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs). The project supports the adoption of e-commerce solutions that enable these businesses to offer their goods and services through digital channels, enhancing their online marketing tools to increase sales and productivity. Objetivos: 1) Recognise and segment needs within at least 4,312 Colombian companies and/or merchants to build capacity through human resource training and development, increasing the use and adoption of the e-commerce value chain. 2) Offer the Colombian business community and the popular economy a web tool for registration, counselling, and management of learning and digital skills assessment, with the technical capacity to diagnose their knowledge and adoption of technology in e-commerce. 3) Implement a specialised asynchronous and/or synchronous consulting programme that enables beneficiaries to make their product offerings available online, strengthening their capabilities through timely implementation of technological tools. 4) Provide a platform that allows at least 4,312 Colombian merchants and/or MSMEs to create or strengthen an e-commerce solution as their primary online marketing channel. Público-alvo: Empreendedores; Microempresas; Pequenas e médias empresas. Temas no STIP: Estratégias de política de inovação empresarial; Competências STEM; Transformação digital das empresas. Instrumentos: Extensão tecnológica e consultoria a empresas; Redes e plataformas colaborativas; orçamento anual informado: de 1 a 5 milhões (o arquivo do STIP não informa a moeda); avaliação: sem avaliação informada. Contexto: The National Planning Department (2023–2026) seeks productive transformation, internationalisation, and climate action. One catalyst focuses on promoting micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises through a strategy that encourages technical, financial, and cultural involvement by adopting digital technologies in the productive sectors.

tipo: Política ou iniciativa de CTI (OECD STIP Compass)

detalhes: Fonte: EC-OECD STIP Compass (Comissão Europeia e OCDE), edição 2025 da pesquisa STIP (dados atualizados até setembro de 2026); iniciativa 200003084, informada pelo governo da Costa Rica; última atualização no STIP: 23/07/2025. Iniciativa: Intelligent Community Centres (Centros Comunitarios Inteligentes) [CECIS]. País: Costa Rica. Período: desde 2006, sem data de término informada. Relação com o tema: política de CTI que inclui mulheres, gênero ou parentalidade entre seus objetivos ou públicos (o governo marcou o tema Equidade, diversidade e inclusão). Responsável: Ministry of Science, Innovation, Technology and Telecommunications (MICITT; Ministerio de Ciencia, Innovación, Tecnología y Telecomunicaciones). Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): The Intelligent Community Centres (CECIs) form a national network of smart community centres across Costa Rica. Each centre houses a laboratory equipped with state-of-the-art computers, providing various services to local communities. These centres aim to technologically empower communities by facilitating access to knowledge, information, creativity, and the ability to tackle new challenges. The next phase of the initiative plans to offer agricultural, livestock, and industrial extension services to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and to train users in utilising the State's digital administration online services. Objetivos: 1) To promote capacity building in Science and Technology to bridge the existing digital divide in Costa Rica through digital literacy. 2) To contribute to the economic and social development of communities by implementing a programme that enables learning, the use of online services, and the development of skills that promote leadership and entrepreneurship in the local community. 3) To develop a network of centres for public access and use of digital technologies, with national coverage, prioritising communities where the digital and social divides are greatest. 4) To implement a continuous monitoring system for the work carried out in the various community centres, which will identify flaws in the design and implementation plan for their correction. Público-alvo: Grupos desfavorecidos e excluídos; Sociedade civil; Pequenas e médias empresas. Temas no STIP: Apoio não financeiro a P&D e inovação nas empresas; Apoio a PMEs e empresas inovadoras jovens; Equidade, diversidade e inclusão (EDI); Transformação digital das empresas. Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): Initiated in 2022 under the name "Federal High-Impact Networks Program," this initiative seeks to promote strategic science with impact by strengthening the National System of Science, Technology, and Innovation (SNCTI). The program funds research networks that integrate local and international groups of excellence with emerging teams to address national development priorities. With a federal focus aimed at reducing territorial and institutional asymmetries, it drives large-scale interdisciplinary projects. Its ultimate goal is to ensure the sector's sustainability through human resource training and the transfer of knowledge into tangible, long-term solutions. Objetivos: 1) Promote high-quality research networks focused on strategic areas for national development. 2) Federal High-Impact Networks: Strategic R&D alliances of research groups within the National STI System, characterized by high-level international engagement and the inclusion of young or early-career researchers. 3) By applying federalization criteria based on researcher density and budget execution, the program aims to reduce regional asymmetries by fostering knowledge transfer and strengthening scientific excellence in relatively less developed zones. Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): This initiative, aims to strengthen national capabilities in the field of quantum science and technology, a priority area within the "National Science, Technology, and Innovation Plan 2030". The program provides funding over three years to set up new experimental laboratories in public institutions. It specifically targets early-career researchers—ideally those residing abroad—to promote repatriation and address technological gaps in areas such as cold atoms, optomechanics, and quantum communications. Objetivos: 1) Strengthen national experimental capabilities in the field of quantum science and technology. 2) Promote the repatriation and reintegration of researchers currently working in this field abroad. 3) Encourage excellence in research regarding quantum information, quantum metrology, and quantum information processing. 4) Develop research with a federal perspective, ensuring the growth of these technologies throughout the country. 5) Foster the training of high-level human resources to build specialized expertise in the quantum sector. Público-alvo: Pós-doutorandos e pesquisadores em início de carreira; Institutos públicos de pesquisa. Temas no STIP: Pesquisa interdisciplinar; Pesquisadores de doutorado e pós-doutorado. Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): This programme provides targeted training in Artificial Intelligence (AI) for the public administration, combining practical skills with foundational knowledge, including core cybersecurity concepts. It aims to familiarise participants with key AI concepts, effective prompting techniques, good practices, and selected use cases that illustrate the adoption and application of AI in government settings. The programme is delivered through a blended format—combining asynchronous learning modules with in-person sessions—and concludes with an integrated final component designed to consolidate learning and support its application in the public sector context. Objetivos: 1) To establish a common baseline of knowledge. 2) To foster innovation within the public administration. 3) To lay the groundwork for its future expansion to other government entities. Objetivos: 1) Promote and raise, through evaluation, the quality of scientific and technological research, and the innovation taking place in Mexico. 2) Contributes to the training and consolidation of researchers with advanced scientific and technological knowledge, considered as an essential element to increase culture, productivity, competitiveness and social well being. 3) Ensure the quality of results of the R&D activities performed by researchers. 4) Evaluate members with high standards, including the production of high quality scientific and technological knowledge. Iniciativa: National Artificial Intelligence Policy (Política Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial) [Política IA]. País: Chile. Período: de 2021 a 2030. Relação com o tema: política de CTI que inclui mulheres, gênero ou parentalidade entre seus objetivos ou públicos (o texto menciona mulheres ou gênero). Trecho sobre mulheres, gênero ou parentalidade: "This includes topics such as privacy, transparency, responsibility, environmental issues, gender-gap, automation impacts, among others.". Responsável: Ministry of Science, Technology, Knowledge and Innovation (MinCiencia; Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología, Conocimiento e Innovación). Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): The Chilean Artificial Intelligence Policy 2021-2030 covers three pillars: (1) enabling factors, (2) development and adoption of AI (3) ethics, regulatory aspects and socio-economic impacts. Objetivos: 1) Insert Chile in the vanguard and global collaboration related to AI, with an ecosystem of research, development and innovation in AI that creates new capabilities in the productive, academic and state sectors, oriented according to cross-cutting principles of opportunity and responsibility, contribute to sustainable development and improve our quality of life. 2) To develop AI's enabling factors which encompasses development of human capital, technological infrastructure and data availability. 3) To foster the use and development of AI which encompasses research, development, innovation, and entrepeneurship based on AI systems. It also foster adoption both in the private and the public sector. 4) To discuss and reach consensus about ethics, standards, cybersecurity and regulation between the private and public sectors for a human-centered development and use of AI. This includes topics such as privacy, transparency, responsibility, environmental issues, gender-gap, automation impacts, among others. detalhes: Fonte: EC-OECD STIP Compass (Comissão Europeia e OCDE), edição 2025 da pesquisa STIP (dados atualizados até setembro de 2026); iniciativa 2694, informada pelo governo do Chile; última atualização no STIP: 11/08/2025. Iniciativa: Chile Scholarships (BECAS CHILE). País: Chile. Período: desde 2008, sem data de término informada. Relação com o tema: política de formação e carreira em CTI que não menciona mulheres nem gênero (temas: Pesquisadores de doutorado e pós-doutorado, Mobilidade internacional de recursos humanos). A descrição não fala de mulheres nem de gênero. Responsável: National Research and Development Agency (ANID; Agencia Nacional de Investigación y Desarrollo). Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): This initiative is an international scholarship programme aimed to support human capital formation abroad. Objetivos: 1) The general objective of this initiative is to improve the quality of the human capital in Chile, by defining a comprehensive long term policy of advanced human capital formation abroad. The programme has three lines of action that correspond to 3 specific objectives of this initiative:. 2) Increase opportunities for basic and advanced training abroad. 3) Streamline and coordinate the government grant programmes. 4) Encourage international cooperation. Público-alvo: Estudantes de graduação e mestrado; Doutorandos. Temas no STIP: Pesquisadores de doutorado e pós-doutorado; Mobilidade internacional de recursos humanos. Instrumentos: Bolsas de estudo, de pesquisa e de pós-graduação; orçamento anual informado: de 50 a 100 milhões (o arquivo do STIP não informa a moeda); avaliação: o governo informa que a iniciativa foi avaliada. Contexto: Education and innovation are strategic pillars of the action plan of the government of Chile. Becas Chile operates in this context. The programme was initiated in October 2008, before the program was called international scholarships. This initiative responds to the urgent need to have more academic, professional and technical excellence, not only more productive but also more creative, innovative and entrepreneurial. Under the proposal submitted by the Presidential Commission, the innovation strategy for this initiative will be drawn for the next four years. This will be delivered during 2016.

Responsável: National Research and Development Agency (ANID; Agencia Nacional de Investigación y Desarrollo). Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): The programme for the placement of doctors in business seeks to create employment opportunities for doctorate holders in the private sector. Objetivos: 1) Contribute to the strengthening of national companies and centers / scientific-technological institutes, through the insertion of advanced human capital. Público-alvo: Laboratórios privados de P&D; Empresas de qualquer idade; Empresas de qualquer porte. Temas no STIP: Mobilidade intersetorial; Carreiras de pesquisa. Instrumentos: Regulação e incentivos à mobilidade de trabalhadores; orçamento anual informado: menos de 1 milhão (o arquivo do STIP não informa a moeda); avaliação: o governo informa que a iniciativa foi avaliada. Contexto: The placement of doctors in the S&T national system is one of the most important challenges for the coming years in Chile, more so because it is expected that in the short term students who have completed their training abroad through the BECAS CHILE program will return to the country. The recently developed program for the placement of doctors should be revised in response to these challenges.

Relação com o tema: política de formação e carreira em CTI que não menciona mulheres nem gênero (temas: Competências STEM). A descrição não fala de mulheres nem de gênero. Responsável: National Council for Science, Technology and Innovation (CONCYTEC; Consejo Nacional de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación); Ministry of Education (MINEDU; Ministerio de Educación). Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): The National School Fair of Science and Technology "Eureka" promotes the use of scientific methodology in the natural sciences and social sciences. It also promotes scientific research fostering a passion for science and technology; and promoting scientific and technological skills and abilities, both in teachers and in regular basic education students. Education in science and technology is important for the development of the country, to obtain appropriate answers and practical solutions to the problems of our environment. Students from the initial, primary and secondary levels of public and private educational institutions participate at the national level. Objetivos: 1) Stimulate ingenuity, scientific intuition and experimental skill in students nationwide. Público-alvo: Professores; Governo nacional; Governos subnacionais; Estudantes do ensino médio. Temas no STIP: Competências STEM; Cultura de ciência, tecnologia e inovação. Contexto: In 2013, the National School Fair of Science and Technology of CONCYTEC, running yearly since 1987, has changed its name to EUREKA, and has increase its scope in order to include foreign countries delegations to compete at the same conditions as the Peruvian delegations from all over the country. Furthermore, the EUREKA Fair of this year (November 14-17) has partnered with INTEL in order to accommodate a side-event titled “Science Educator Academy”, which will gather delegations from 9 Latin American countries including representatives from their Ministry of Education and their National S&T Agencies.

Responsável: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development (MADR; Ministerio de Agricultura y Desarrollo Rural). Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): The Agricultural Science, Technology and Innovation Tables are construction spaces that become an opportunity to articulate local actors around the increase in the generation, accumulation, dissemination, application and appropriation of knowledge and technologies of the agricultural sector in their territory, In order to achieve in this way the use of opportunities and instruments that the national government, cooperation, the private sector, among others, have been arranged for this purpose. Objetivos: 1) Improve the corporatisation of agricultural activities, access to markets and achieve the continuous improvement of productivity and competitiveness of production chains, in the framework of the concept of sustainable production. 2) Contribute to improving living conditions, income and employment in the poorest rural territories of the country. 3) Articulate local actors around territorial innovation systems for the generation, accumulation, diffusion, application and appropriation of knowledge and technologies of the agricultural sector in their territory. 4) Guarantee that the generation and adoption of knowledge and technologies in the agricultural sector is carried out in accordance with environmental and social and productive organization of the territory. 5) 3. Adopt the PECTIA and the National R & D & I Dynamic Agenda as the guiding framework for planning, prioritizing, financing, executing and evaluation of agricultural research, development and innovation stakes at the territorial level. 6) Raise, through its president, requests and recommendations in matters of science, technology and innovation to the National Council of Secretaries of Agriculture (CONSA). Público-alvo: Grupos desfavorecidos e excluídos; Instituições de ensino superior; Governo nacional; Governos subnacionais.

Iniciativa: Innovation Law 2004 - Human Resources (Lei de Inovação 2004 - Recursos Humanos). País: Brasil. Período: desde 2004, sem data de término informada. Relação com o tema: política de formação e carreira em CTI que não menciona mulheres nem gênero (temas: Estratégias de recursos humanos em CTI). A descrição não fala de mulheres nem de gênero. Responsável: Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (MCTI; Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação). Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): This is a legislative initiative that allows the government to provide the private sector with incentives to foster the development of science, technology and innovation. Objetivos: 1) The Innovation Law N. 10973/2004 allows the federal government to provide, directly, business sector with competitive grants. It allows Public Scientific and Technological Institutions (PSTIs) to share equipment, instruments, laboratories and other infrastructures with private enterprises. This law also provides a legal framework for public employes participation and remuneration concerning innovation activities. Público-alvo: Pesquisadores estabelecidos; Investidores privados; Empreendedores; Instituições de ensino superior; Institutos públicos de pesquisa; Laboratórios privados de P&D; Governo nacional; Empresas de qualquer idade; Empresas de qualquer porte; Incubadoras, aceleradoras e parques tecnológicos; Escritórios de transferência de tecnologia. Temas no STIP: Estratégias de recursos humanos em CTI. Instrumentos: Estratégias, agendas e planos; orçamento anual informado: não se aplica (o arquivo do STIP não informa a moeda); avaliação: sem avaliação informada. Contexto: Prior to the Innovation Law N. 10973/2004, support to companies R&D and innovation activities had to be carried out through universities and research organisations. This initiative was adopted on 2 December 2004. In the meanwhile, this initiative was updated by the Law N. 13.243, approved on 11 January 2016.

The Costa Rican Olympiad in Biological Sciences is a program that promotes active, participatory and meaningful study of biology. Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): The Millennium Science Initiative (ICM) aims to promote the development of cutting edge scientific and technological research in the country, as a key factor for sustainable, long-term economic and social development. Objetivos: 1) Contribute to the increase in Chile’s competitiveness, by improving the quantity and quality of cutting edge S&T research in the country and encouraging researchers to work in synergic groups in order to confront new problems and generate new knowledge. 2) Stimulates and supports the collaborative work of scientific groups through the creation of Centers of Research - "Millennium Institutes" and "Nuclei" - which carry out scientific research that can be compared to that done in more developed countries, in both the natural and exact sciences as well as the social sciences. 3) Contribute to an increase in knowledge in different disciplines, in order to provide solutions for the various challenges that the country faces. 4) Reduce the “brain drain”, as well as attracting excellent Chilean and foreign scientists currently working in other countries to the national system of scientific-technological research. Público-alvo: Instituições de ensino superior; Laboratórios privados de P&D. Temas no STIP: Financiamento competitivo da pesquisa; Carreiras de pesquisa; Mobilidade internacional de recursos humanos; Cultura de ciência, tecnologia e inovação. Instrumentos: Financiamento de centros de excelência (Millennium Nucleus Centers); Financiamento de centros de excelência (Millennium Institutes); orçamento anual informado: de 5 a 20 milhões (o arquivo do STIP não informa a moeda); avaliação: o governo informa que a iniciativa foi avaliada.

(continuação) Contexto: The Chilean ICM Programme is implemented in the framework of the international Millennium Science Initiative, a project of the World Bank and the Science Initiative Group to build capacity in science and technology in the developing world. Work to prepare a project to implement the Millennium Science Initiative in Chile started in 1988. In January 1999 a decision was made to deliver to the Ministry of Planning (Mideplan) the responsibility of implementing this Program, adding up to the efforts made on this matter by the Ministries of Education, Economics, Agriculture, Mining and other public and private organizations. As from 1 January 2011, the Millennium Science Initiative program ceases to be a part of the Ministry of Planning and it is transferred to the Ministry of Economics, Development and Tourism. The transfer is mainly based on the fact that given the new institutional structure related to science, technology and innovation development, it is that Minister the one responsible for directing and coordinating the Science, Technology and Innovation National System and its components.

Responsável: Secretariat of Science, Humanities, Technology and Innovation (SECIHTI; Secretaría de Ciencia, Humanidades, Tecnología e Innovación). Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): Programme that promotes the labor insertion of young researchers. Objetivos: 1) Promote the participation of humanists, scientists, technologists and innovators in the execution of the State policy articulated by the Federal Government through CONAHCYT. 2) Facilitate employment opportunities for professionals in research centers, higher education institutions, and public sector entities, including state productive companies. 3) Create optimal working conditions that promote productivity and career growth. 4) Promote public policies in the areas of humanities, sciences, technologies, and innovation that serve the public interest, national sovereignty, scientific and technological independence, national development, environmental conservation, biocultural preservation, and the well-being of the Mexican people. Público-alvo: Pós-doutorandos e pesquisadores em início de carreira; Professores. Temas no STIP: Carreiras de pesquisa. Contexto: This programme arises as an initiative aimed at supporting young researchers with the purpose of reducing the gap that separates the supply and demand of places in the humanities, sciences, technologies and innovation sector; The emphasis of the Program is placed on the professional development of researchers in optimal conditions that allow them to access employment opportunities. It prioritises the solution of national problems through CONAHCYT's defined priority projects and programmatic axes. Formerly known as Cátedras Conacyt.

Iniciativa: Science Promotion in Developing Countries [TWAS]. País: Brasil. Período: desde 1983, sem data de término informada. Relação com o tema: política de formação e carreira em CTI que não menciona mulheres nem gênero (temas: Pesquisadores de doutorado e pós-doutorado, Mobilidade internacional de recursos humanos). A descrição não fala de mulheres nem de gênero. Responsável: Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (MCTI; Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação). Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): TWAS was founded by a distinguished group of scientists from the developing world. Objetivos: 1) To promote scientific excellence and possibilities for scientific development in Southern countries through South-South postgraduate and postdoctoral scholarship programs. 2) To promote mobility of researchers. 3) To support the “ grants ” research. 4) To support recognition of scientists. Público-alvo: Pós-doutorandos e pesquisadores em início de carreira. Temas no STIP: Pesquisadores de doutorado e pós-doutorado; Mobilidade internacional de recursos humanos; Pesquisa e inovação para países em desenvolvimento. Instrumentos: Financiamento de projetos de pesquisa pública; Bolsas de estudo, de pesquisa e de pós-graduação (TWAS); orçamento anual informado: menos de 1 milhão (o arquivo do STIP não informa a moeda); avaliação: sem avaliação informada. Contexto: The group of scientists that founded TWAS shared a belief that developing nations, by building strength in science and engineering, could build the knowledge and skill to address such challenges as hunger, disease and poverty. From the start, the Academy had essential support from Italian scientists and political leaders. Since 2004, the National Council for Scientific and Technological Development (CNPq - Brazil) and TWAS have launched Calls, annually, which provide for the offer of doctoral and postdoctoral scholarships in Brazil, in the field of natural sciences, to developing countries. There were more than 350 foreign beneficiaries, who were able to develop their research in Brazilian universities. The nationalities of the researchers include countries such as Pakistan, Cuba, Benin, Cameroon, Egypt, Nigeria and Kenya. MCTI voluntarily contributes to the TWAS.

Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): The strategy is oriented towards an economy with fossil decarbonization, competitiveness, sustainability and inclusion, through a convergence and coherence between productive development and environmental policies. Objetivos: 1) Making Costa Rica a model country in sustainable development, taking advantage of its biological resources to promote social inclusion and equity, balanced territorial development, conservation, knowledge and sustainable use of its biodiversity, and national competitiveness. 2) Making the bioeconomy one of the pillars of the productive transformation of Costa Rica, promoting innovation, value addition, diversification and sophistication of its economy, applying the principles of circular bioeconomy and seeking fossil decarbonization of production and consumption processes. 3) Promoting convergence between the countrys wealth in biological resources and the use of national capacities in biological sciences for the valorization of that wealth. Período: desde 2021, sem data de término informada. Relação com o tema: política de CTI que inclui mulheres, gênero ou parentalidade entre seus objetivos ou públicos (o governo marcou Mulheres entre os grupos-alvo). Responsável: Ministry of Science, Technology, Knowledge and Innovation (MinCiencia; Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología, Conocimiento e Innovación). Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): Digital platform gathering Chile's science, technology, knowledge, and innovation (STKI) data and indicators characterizing its capacities and production on these matters. Objetivos: 1) To support evidence based decision and policy making, as well as to inform the citizenry and relevant Chile’s STKI system stakeholders. Público-alvo: Pesquisadores estabelecidos; Doutorandos; Professores; Mulheres; Sociedade civil; Instituições de ensino superior; Laboratórios privados de P&D; Governos subnacionais; Empresas de qualquer porte; Escritórios de transferência de tecnologia; Sociedades científicas e academias. Temas no STIP: Inteligência estratégica de políticas; Acesso aberto a publicações; Acesso ampliado a dados e software. Instrumentos: Serviços de informação e acesso a dados; Criação ou reforma de órgão público ou estrutura de governança; orçamento anual informado: não se aplica (o arquivo do STIP não informa a moeda); avaliação: sem avaliação informada. Contexto: The need of creating a platform gathering all the data and information of the Chilean STKI system arose from the Law 21105, which created the Ministry of Science. In its article 5, letter i, points out that the Ministry must maintain and manage, in a coordinated manner with other public bodies, information regarding the capacities and production of the country in science, technology and science-based innovation. In the same way, it must maintain and manage statistics and information of public interest regarding the resources that the organisms of the State administration deliver to the public and private sectors in these matters. (continuação) Following that mandate, Observa seeks to deliver reliable technical information in a clear, open and transparent way, reaching both the citizens and STKI system stakeholders, and thus provide evidence and analysis that allows to support public policy decision-making.

Responsável: Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (MINCIENCIAS; Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación). Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): The Ondas Program of the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation is the main strategy for fostering scientific vocations among children and youth. Its objective is to promote interest in research among boys, girls, and adolescents, as well as to develop attitudes and skills that enable them to actively participate in a culture of Science, Technology and Innovation (STI). The program also recognizes children and adolescents as key differential actors for change under the chapter “A Generation Grows for Life and Peace: Children and Adolescents Protected, Loved, and with Opportunities,” promoting their comprehensive development and prioritizing those living in poverty or at risk. Aligned with the national commitment to reducing regional disparities, the Ondas Program implements clear actions with a differential, ethnic, and territorial approach, encouraging the identification of problems faced by children and adolescents, while building local capacities around Bioeconomy and Territory, Energy Transition, and Environmental Protection.

Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): One of the most significant contemporary challenges is to learn, exchange and build knowledge based on science, technology and innovation (CTeI), so that social groups can use said knowledge to improve our quality of life. Therefore, it is essential to promote and generate processes of Social Appropriation of Knowledge. From the Ministry and within the framework of the Public Policy of Social Appropriation of Knowledge, we understand that the Social Appropriation of Knowledge is a deliberate process that involves all social actors: the scientific community, civil society, the business sector and the State. This process seeks to promote practices of exchange, dialogue, analysis, reaction and negotiation through the management, production and application of science, technology and innovation in environments of trust, equity and inclusion. The objective is that more and more citizens are capable of managing, communicating, generating and appropriating CTeI in different areas of life and in their respective territories.

Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): The Costa Rican Physics Olympiad is an academic competition for students in the field of physics whose main objective is to develop the necessary vocations for the training of comprehensive scientists. The competition is aimed at tenth and eleventh grade students with an interest in the physics. These Olympiad categories are divided into BB for tenth grade students and AA for eleventh grade students which compete in into two stages. Objetivos: 1) To develop scientific knowledge, particularly that of Physics, in secondary school youth throughhigh-quality academic tests. 2) Contribute to the scientific and pedagogical development of High school Physics teachers. Contexto: The Costa Rican Physics Olympiad (OLCOFI) promotes the generation of more scientific development of Physics, through an active participation of students at the national and international level, both from private and public education schools, where the level of the Olympiads exams reflects the development of creative talent and logical-mathematical intelligence. In addition, an organizing committee perform a vital function for the consolidation of a more equitable competition and with more scientific culture.

Responsável: Secretariat of Science, Humanities, Technology and Innovation (SECIHTI; Secretaría de Ciencia, Humanidades, Tecnología e Innovación). Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): In accordance with the National Development Plan, Conahcyt implements actions to provide support to students from indigenous communities who wish to undertake or are already undertaking postgraduate studies. Contexto: In accordance with the National Development Plan 2019-2024, affirmative actions are implemented to provide support focused on historically excluded population groups. Between 1 September 2020 and 30 June 2021, a total of 3,571 scholarships were administered to support specific populations to promote social inclusion, of which 22.7% (812) went to students from indigenous populations to pursue postgraduate studies, 77.1% (2,754) to Mexican mothers who are heads of household to pursue full-time, school-based professional studies, and 0.2% (5) to incorporate students with disabilities to pursue postgraduate studies.

detalhes: Fonte: EC-OECD STIP Compass (Comissão Europeia e OCDE), edição 2025 da pesquisa STIP (dados atualizados até setembro de 2026); iniciativa 99996348, informada pelo governo do Brasil; última atualização no STIP: 11/08/2025. Iniciativa: New Curriculum to Form Engineers Capable of Innovating and to Managing Innovation (Novo curriculo para formar engenheiros capazes de inovater and gerir innovacao: Insper and Isitec.). País: Brasil. Período: desde 2013, sem data de término informada. Relação com o tema: política de formação e carreira em CTI que não menciona mulheres nem gênero (temas: Estratégias de recursos humanos em CTI). A descrição não fala de mulheres nem de gênero. Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): Both are ongoing programs, both in São Paulo. Both are non for profit, non governmental institutions. INSPER is an institute certified by the Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business - AASCP. ISITEC is an institute created by the Union of Engineers of São Paulo, consisting of a Faculty of Engineering of Innovation. Objetivos: 1) Form engineers inclined to innovate and to undertake business. 2) Form engineers who learn how to learn and to adapt their actions to fast changing technologies. 3) Form engineers able to start their own innovative business. Público-alvo: Estudantes de graduação e mestrado; Instituições de ensino superior; Laboratórios privados de P&D. Temas no STIP: Estratégias de recursos humanos em CTI. Instrumentos: Extensão tecnológica e consultoria a empresas; avaliação: o governo informa que a iniciativa foi avaliada. Contexto: Both derive from the perception that traditional curriculum in different areas of engineering are outdated, too broad and not specialized enough to form engineers trained to learn new skills permanently and, more important: to innovate and manage innovation and to be entrepreneurs themselves. The new courses and innovative curriculum have been examined and approved by the Ministry of Education.

Responsável: National Planning Department (DNP; Departamento Nacional de Planeación). Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): The Science, Technology and Innovation (STI) Allocation of the General Royalties System (SGR) consists of the implementation of public, open and competitive calls, in which any actor of the National STI System can present and execute projects that seek to increase the scientific, technological, innovation and competitiveness capacity of the regions. Objetivos: 1) Increase the scientific, technological, innovation and competitiveness capacity of the regions through projects that contribute to the production, use, integration and appropriation of knowledge in the economy and society in general. Público-alvo: Pesquisadores estabelecidos; Estudantes de graduação e mestrado; Pós-doutorandos e pesquisadores em início de carreira; Doutorandos; Professores; Sociedade civil; Instituições de ensino superior; Institutos públicos de pesquisa; Laboratórios privados de P&D; Empresas de qualquer porte; Incubadoras, aceleradoras e parques tecnológicos; Sociedades científicas e academias. Contexto: Royalties are the economic consideration received by the country for the exploitation of a non-renewable natural resource, such as oil and gas. In 2011, the SGR was created to distribute resources taking into account a greater impact on the entire population. For the year 2019 a reform to the SGR was promoted, which created a new distribution of resources. Of these resources, 10% is destined for STI, benefiting all departments.

Iniciativa: General Law on Humanities, Sciences, Technologies and Innovation (Ley General en Materia de Humanidades, Ciencias, Tecnologías e Innovación) [HSTI]. País: México. Período: desde 2023, sem data de término informada. Responsável: National Council for Humanities, Science and Technology (CONAHCYT; Consejo Nacional de Humanidades, Ciencias y Tecnologías). Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): The Law guarantees the human right to science, strengthens the National Council of Humanities, Sciences and Technologies (Conacyt) as the National Council of Humanities, Sciences and Technologies (Conahcyt), does not restrict freedom of research and promotes increased public funding of progressive way and without regressions; supports the plurality, existence and respect of our ancient cultures and makes knowledge a common good. Objetivos: 1) To guarantee the exercise of the human right to science in accordance with the principles of universality, interdependence, indivisibility and progressivity. 2) Establish the purposes, principles and bases of public policies in the field of humanities, sciences, technologies and innovation, as well as the criteria and means for their formulation, execution and evaluation. 3) Establish the public mechanisms and instruments for the necessary resources and stimuli in order to promote and support training, research, dissemination and development of projects in the field of humanity, science, technology and innovation, as well as open access to information derived from said activities. 4) Establish the attributions of the National Council of Humanities, Sciences and Technologies, as the coordinating body of the National System of Humanities, Sciences, Technologies and Innovation, as well as in charge of formulating and conducting the national policy in matters of humanities, sciences, technologies and innovation. 5) Establish the recognition, coordination, articulation and operation of the Public Centers for Humanistic and Scientific Research, Technological Development and Innovation.

Relação com o tema: política de formação e carreira em CTI que não menciona mulheres nem gênero (temas: Estratégias de recursos humanos em CTI, Competências STEM, Pesquisadores de doutorado e pós-doutorado). A descrição não fala de mulheres nem de gênero. Responsável: National Council for Humanities, Science and Technology (CONAHCYT; Consejo Nacional de Humanidades, Ciencias y Tecnologías). Descrição (texto informado pelo governo): National Postgraduate System promotes research and training based on social relevance for the advancement of knowledge. Objetivos: 1) Make the most of and articulate the capacities of Higher Education Institutions and public research centers. 2) Promote academic rigor, epistemological and disciplinary plurality of postgraduate programs, as well as critical thinking. 3) That the new generations develop the necessary skills to carry out and lead humanistic or scientific research, technological developments and innovations. 4) Influence, through postgraduates, in areas or issues of strategic or priority attention for the public interest. Público-alvo: Estudantes de graduação e mestrado; Pós-doutorandos e pesquisadores em início de carreira; Doutorandos; Instituições de ensino superior; Institutos públicos de pesquisa. tipo: Política ou iniciativa de CTI (OECD STIP Compass)
